notes.title: Second limited time test is starting!
notes.content:
If you have any questions, thoughts, feedback, etc., you can message or comment me on various platforms, or add me on QQ for a chat: 2763245241 

The content of this game update is as follows:

1.Severe bug: stepping on the solar panel is judged as death = Fixed

2.The problem of inconvenient exit in full screen mode 
= 1 Set the default startup to windowed mode, 2 Add resolution adjustment option, 3 Add exit to main page button in the non-tutorial part of the game, 4 Add direct close game button
= Because changed to the default windowed mode, it turns out to greatly saved GPU performance!


3.The problem of “can’t find the sound source” = Added multiple hints

4.Hope to add manual save function = Responded

5.The problem of too light prompt font = Bold and enlarged

6.The problems of various aspects of the tutorial = 1 Added two kinds of prompt texts, 2 Picking up the flag from manual trigger to automatic trigger, 3 Lock blood to avoid death in the tutorial

7.Adjustment of materials, plot texts, etc.
